content.short: UDlink creates readable URLs for Unstoppable Domains IPFS sites, shareable across Web2 and updating automatically when your domain changes.
content.description: Sharing links to Web3 sites can be tricky when native browser support isn't universal. If your site uses Unstoppable Domains, UDlink makes it possible to distribute those links across Web2, while automatically updating them each time you modify your domain. You can direct users to specific pages or anchor points on your site and decide which IPFS gateway to serve the content from. In short, UDlink keeps your URLs reliable, consistent, and easy to share, even as your domain changes.
content.meta: UDlink gives readable URLs for Unstoppable Domains IPFS sites, accessible from any site. Discover UDlink and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
